description: One member of the circle: status, stake, outstanding debt and credit limit (read API GET /members/{account} and /limits, or the contract views member and limit when no read API is set). Use it after x207_circle_overview has shown the account ids, or before paying a member; for epoch-level amounts use x207_epoch_report. Returns {account, member, limits|limit, source, warnings}. An account that is not a member is an error ("not a member" or a 404 from the read API); a failed limits lookup is only a warning.

account.description: The member to look up: its NEAR account id, or for an EVM agent its lower-case 0x address.

name: x207_member_inspect
title: Inspect a circle member
